# Chemaclass

> Personal website of Jose Maria Valera Reales (Chemaclass). Software engineer and open source contributor sharing practical insights on software craftsmanship, TDD, leadership, Bitcoin, and AI.

## About

Jose Maria Valera Reales is a Product Engineer at Kombo with 15+ years in software engineering and 5+ in leadership. He writes about software craftsmanship, testing, leadership, Bitcoin, and AI. The site is available in English and Spanish.

## Sections

- [Blog](https://chemaclass.com/blog/): Articles on software development, testing, leadership, and team building
- [Readings](https://chemaclass.com/readings/): Book summaries and reading notes across software, psychology, and philosophy
- [Talks](https://chemaclass.com/talks/): Conference talks and workshops on testing, refactoring, and software craftsmanship
- [Services](https://chemaclass.com/services/): Web development and team workshops
- [CV](https://chemaclass.com/cv/): Professional experience and skills

## Series

Curated groups of posts. Each post stands on its own, and the order below is the suggested path, not a prerequisite.

- [Bitcoin Series](https://chemaclass.com/series/bitcoin/) (6 posts): Pretty Good Privacy | The Cypherpunks | Programmable Money | Understanding Taxes | Bitcoin Fundamentals | How Bitcoin Works
- [AI Series](https://chemaclass.com/series/ai/) (9 posts): AI Gives You Speed, Not Quality | MCP: Giving Your AI Agent the Right Context | Build Your Own Team of Agents | Idealism vs Pragmatism | Inside the .claude Folder | The Levels of AI Adoption | Skills Over Agents | Cut the Token Bill on Both Ends | The Human Bottleneck
- [Software Craftsmanship Series](https://chemaclass.com/series/craftsmanship/) (13 posts): Great Engineering | Different Beliefs About Software Quality | The Art of Testing: Where Design Meets Quality | Test-Driven (Development) | TDD vs BDD | London vs Chicago | To Mock or Not to Mock | How to Test Private Methods? | The Art of Refactoring | Testing Effectively Legacy Code | Effective Pair Programming | Pull Requests vs Pair Programming | Dedicated QA Teams in Software?
- [Leadership & Teams Series](https://chemaclass.com/series/leadership/) (8 posts): Responsibilities of a Tech Lead | Red Work vs Blue Work | The Path to Seniority in Software | The Beauty of Leadership | Great Leadership | How Do You Get Everyone on Board? | Forming, Storming, Norming and Performing | Working With the Garage Door Open
- [Agile & XP Series](https://chemaclass.com/series/agile/) (6 posts): Update Your Team to Be More Extreme | Working Agile with Non-Agile Teams | Ignoring Scrum to Get More Agile? | Deployments on Fridays | What Kills Agility? | Ship, Show, Ask

## Topics

- [Leadership & People](https://chemaclass.com/topics/#leadership-people): Growing as a leader, building great teams, and the human side of software
- [Mind & Knowledge](https://chemaclass.com/topics/#mind-knowledge): Philosophy, psychology, productivity, and the pursuit of understanding
- [Software Craft & Testing](https://chemaclass.com/topics/#software-craft-testing): TDD, clean code, refactoring, and design practices
- [Bitcoin & Economics](https://chemaclass.com/topics/#bitcoin-economics): Sound money, Austrian economics, privacy, and Bitcoin technology
- [Programming Languages & Tools](https://chemaclass.com/topics/#programming-languages-tools): PHP, Bash, Lisp, Symfony, Docker, Git
- [AI & Agents](https://chemaclass.com/topics/#ai-agents): Working with AI agents, agentic coding, and what the tooling changes about the craft
- [Speaking & Teaching](https://chemaclass.com/topics/#speaking-teaching): Conference talks, workshops, live coding

## Open Source

- [Phel](https://phel-lang.org): A Lisp that compiles to PHP
- [bashunit](https://bashunit.com/): Testing framework for Bash scripts
- [agnostic-ai](https://agnostic-ai.org/): One spec for AI agents, skills, rules, and hooks, synced to the native files every AI coding tool reads

## Feeds

- [Atom (EN)](https://chemaclass.com/atom.xml): Every new post and reading note in English
- [Atom (ES)](https://chemaclass.com/es/atom.xml): Every new post and reading note in Spanish
- [JSON Feed (EN)](https://chemaclass.com/feed.json): The same English entries as JSON Feed 1.1
- [JSON Feed (ES)](https://chemaclass.com/es/feed.json): The same Spanish entries as JSON Feed 1.1
- [Sitemap](https://chemaclass.com/sitemap.xml): Every indexable page in both languages
- [Full content](https://chemaclass.com/llms-full.txt): The whole corpus as one text file, for AI agents
- [Content index](https://chemaclass.com/index.json): Machine-readable index of every entry, with dates and word counts
- [AI use policy](https://chemaclass.com/ai.txt): Retrieval, citation and training are permitted under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); name the source
- [Site search](https://chemaclass.com/opensearch.xml): OpenSearch description

## Content index

Every blog post, reading note and talk, generated at build time.
